plan.planning_summary: Refining route_02 (24-layer HfO2/SiO2 dichroic stack) based on iteration_20 results showing best_target_score of 0.916. Following feedback directive to apply systematic boundary-scan protocol: decouple edge-coupling optimization from internal resonance by fixing central layers while freeing boundary layers. Planning 3 complementary routes: (1) boundary-focused optimization per directive, (2) expanded 28-layer stack to test layer-count ceiling, (3) robustness-weighted variant to improve tolerance sensitivity. All routes preserve the 24/28-layer alternating HfO2/SiO2 topology with fused silica substrate and air incidence.

routes.title: Boundary-Decoupled Edge Optimization on 24-Layer Stack
routes.scientific_hypothesis: The latest score improvement (0.909 to 0.916) originated primarily from boundary-layer adjustments rather than central resonant layers; isolating boundary degrees of freedom (layers 0-3 and 20-23) while freezing central layers (4-19) at iteration_20 best values will reveal whether edge-coupling optimization can further improve dual-band performance without disrupting internal interference conditions.
routes.design_principle: Decouple edge-coupling optimization from internal resonance tuning by fixing proven central layer thicknesses and allowing full optimizer freedom only at air-film and film-substrate interfaces where impedance matching most strongly affects broadband transmission and reflection.
routes.proposed_topology: 24-layer alternating HfO2/SiO2 stack on fused silica substrate, air incidence. Layer sequence: HfO2(0), SiO2(1), HfO2(2), SiO2(3), HfO2(4), SiO2(5), HfO2(6), SiO2(7), HfO2(8), SiO2(9), HfO2(10), SiO2(11), HfO2(12), SiO2(13), HfO2(14), SiO2(15), HfO2(16), SiO2(17), HfO2(18), SiO2(19), HfO2(20), SiO2(21), HfO2(22), SiO2(23). Total finite layers: 24.
design_variables: thicknesses_nm for layers 0-3 and 20-23 (8 variables); layers 4-19 fixed to iteration_20 best candidate values
soft_objectives: Maximize mean transmittance in 1530-1565 nm band
Maximize mean reflectance in 400-700 nm band
manufacturing_considerations: Thickness bounds 50-280 nm for optimized layers
Fixed layers retain proven manufacturable values
theory_basis: Transfer-matrix method for coherent thin-film interference
Impedance matching theory for air-film and film-substrate interfaces

expected_advantages: Isolates boundary-layer contribution to performance improvement
Reduces optimization dimensionality from 24 to 8 variables for faster convergence
Preserves proven internal resonance structure from iteration_20
known_risks: Boundary-layer changes may disrupt carefully tuned internal interference if coupling is stronger than hypothesized
Freezing 16 layers may prevent discovery of globally superior configurations
routes.execution_request_english: Design a 24-layer alternating HfO2/SiO2 dichroic stack on fused silica substrate with air incidence at normal angle. Initialize layer thicknesses to iteration_20 best candidate values: [77.18, 127.42, 59.02, 106.51, 103.69, 102.04, 251.49, 58.47, 224.32, 105.91, 53.27, 91.43, 222.25, 66.18, 67.71, 74.85, 55.68, 94.62, 161.84, 234.50, 54.81, 81.35, 186.93, 53.33] nm. Score using coherent TMM at normal incidence, unpolarized light, over 400-1600 nm wavelength range. Optimize for simultaneous mean transmittance maximization in 1530-1565 nm and mean reflectance maximization in 400-700 nm bands. routes.revision_reason: Following feedback directive to apply systematic boundary-scan protocol: decouple edge-coupling from internal resonance by fixing central layers 4-19 to iteration_20 best values and optimizing only boundary layers 0-3 and 20-23.

routes.title: Expanded 28-Layer Dichroic Stack with Full Optimization
routes.scientific_hypothesis: Increasing layer count from 24 to 28 (still within 30-layer manufacturing limit) provides additional degrees of freedom for spectral shaping, enabling sharper band-edge transitions and higher dual-band performance without proportionally increasing fabrication complexity.
routes.design_principle: Extend the alternating HfO2/SiO2 topology by 4 layers while maintaining the same material pair and optimization strategy, testing whether the 30-layer ceiling permits meaningful performance gains over the 24-layer baseline.

routes.title: Robustness-Weighted 24-Layer Stack Optimization
routes.scientific_hypothesis: The 24-layer stack achieves high target_score (0.916) but robustness_score (0.477) has plateaued; explicitly weighting robustness in the optimization objective will produce designs with better tolerance to thickness variation while maintaining acceptable dual-band performance.
routes.design_principle: Modify the optimization objective to include robustness_score as a weighted component alongside target_score, trading marginal target performance for improved manufacturing tolerance sensitivity.
routes.proposed_topology: 24-layer alternating HfO2/SiO2 stack on fused silica substrate, air incidence. Layer sequence: HfO2(0), SiO2(1), HfO2(2), SiO2(3), HfO2(4), SiO2(5), HfO2(6), SiO2(7), HfO2(8), SiO2(9), HfO2(10), SiO2(11), HfO2(12), SiO2(13), HfO2(14), SiO2(15), HfO2(16), SiO2(17), HfO2(18), SiO2(19), HfO2(20), SiO2(21), HfO2(22), SiO2(23). routes.execution_request_english: Design a 24-layer alternating HfO2/SiO2 dichroic stack on fused silica substrate with air incidence at normal angle. Initialize layer thicknesses to iteration_20 best candidate values: [77.18, 127.42, 59.02, 106.51, 103.69, 102.04, 251.49, 58.47, 224.32, 105.91, 53.27, 91.43, 222.25, 66.18, 67.71, 74.85, 55.68, 94.62, 161.84, 234.50, 54.81, 81.35, 186.93, 53.33] nm. routes.revision_reason: Addressing robustness_score plateau (0.477 across iterations 12-20) by explicitly weighting tolerance sensitivity in optimization objective to produce more manufacturable designs.

research_influence: Evidence ID s2-chunk:CorpusId:92993850:s2chunk:92993850:1765:3736:69b2ad685bc8c493 confirms telecom C-band (1550 nm) importance for satellite quantum communication, motivating the 1530-1565 nm transmission band priority in all routes.
